purpose: Recommendation for audio Duration HH:MM:SS:FF using own-file MDB editing clock and exact preserved samples.
status: Proposal for current user review. Existing MDB-only source and six formatting principles remain approved; new qualification, audio-clock semantic extension, tie and zero-edge details are not newly approved.

methods.independentArithmetic: Python fractions.Fraction; seven deterministic explicit-NDF examples and half-frame error bound assertions.

proposal.durationPair: Preserve own MDFL Length and SampleRate without changing samples or substituting audio Sample Rate column sources.
proposal.displayClock: Qualified own-file MDB CPNT EditRate, or appropriately supported own-media-slot representation; do not borrow master/project rate.
proposal.scope: Audio Frame Rate column stays blank. This clock is internal to Duration presentation.
proposal.interpretation: Applying the verified Avid decimal-rate convention to typed audio editing clocks is proposed; native audio Duration UI use is not proven. Do not alias audio sampling frequency or generic nearby rational values.
proposal.rounding: Nearest whole display frame once at final quotient; propose exact positive half-frame upward.
proposal.numbering: Use supported nominal base only after exact frame conversion, with compatible qualified recorded DF setting; keep HH:MM:SS:FF colons and no day wrap.
proposal.zero: Proposal: established zero pair displays zeros even without display clock; missing count or invalid sample clock is not established zero. Positive valid audio rounding to zero also displays zeros.
proposal.unavailablePositive: Blank if a required display clock is unusable; retain exact audio and file; no guessed 25/30fps and no header recovery.
proposal.countNotEndPosition: Duration is a count from zero, without source start-timecode offset or inclusive-end +1.
proposal.implementation: Small pure helper with exact runtime numeric records, cancellation/checked wide arithmetic, and availability separate from numeric zero; no per-row formatted string required.

primaryDocumentation.scope: Public CTMS distinction between rational editRate, duration, durationTC and dropframe. Does not establish private MDB owner selection or native MC audio Duration cell.
Public conventional rational/decimal rate labels; not audio UI proof.

nextReview: Qualified recorded drop-frame owner/reference and missing/conflicting/incompatible flag behavior; full priority-table discussion stays deferred.
